capabilities: View SVG files with pan, pinch, and configurable wheel zoom
Edit SVG source in a syntax-highlighted live editor with manual or auto save
Export the current view as PNG at 1x-4x resolution
Preview SVGs against background presets like dot grid, checkerboard, or dark/light
Show zoom, reset, and expand hover controls on SVGs embedded in notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian displays SVG files as static images with no way to inspect, pan, zoom, or edit their source inside the vault.
summary: SVG viewer and editor that opens .svg files with pan and zoom, a syntax-highlighted source editor, PNG export, and hover controls on embedded SVGs.
